_help: The repo's identity & posture — the one file baseline requires (schema: schema/repo.schema.json). copy this in as the first act of adoption and confirm type. Keys starting with _ are inline notes and are ignored.
_type: node | python | service | library | docs — what this repo IS. Supersedes filesystem auto-detection.
_maturity: prototype | claimed | released — scrutiny rises with maturity (CLAIM rules activate at 'claimed').
_workflow: multi-lane (default — a solo dev gets it too) | multi-lane-local (admit and reconcile work from origin alone, never the forge) | single-lane (readiness-only). Under check and orient the forge is closed on every posture. No shipped v3 rule declares a workflow and the lane verb is gone; the value is declared posture, and DESC-03 flags a move down the ladder (multi-lane > multi-lane-local > single-lane) as a weakening.
_anchoring: strict | relaxed | off — work-to-issue anchoring strictness, orthogonal to workflow.
_lanes: The lane namespace agent branches and their session records (records/sessions/<lane>/) are keyed by. Read by no rule under check or orient; its remaining consumers (admit's sister-branch scan, reconcile's lease derivation, log's record path) are the D13 ledger follow-up. namespace is a DESC-03 structural field — changing it is a weakening. Omit the block on a readiness-only (single-lane) descriptor.
